context: Tests whether the agent uses `git worktree repair` (not prune or recreate) to reconnect a relocated worktree, verifies the registration by re-listing, and produces a completion report that captures the before/after state with paths and branch information.

checklist.name: Worktree repair command
checklist.description: repair-report.md documents that `git worktree repair` was the command used to restore the broken registration (not `git worktree prune`, not removing and re-adding the worktree)

checklist.name: Registration preserved
checklist.description: The after-state in repair-report.md shows the same number of worktrees as the before-state (the feature worktree registration was repaired, not deleted by prune)

checklist.name: Absolute path in repair command
checklist.description: The repair command shown in repair-report.md uses an absolute path (starting with `/`) to the worktree, not a relative path like `./`

checklist.name: Targets pipeline-v2 location
checklist.description: The repair command in repair-report.md references `pipeline-v2` as the worktree path (the current/new location, not the old `data-pipeline` location)

checklist.name: Before-state documented
checklist.description: repair-report.md includes output from `git worktree list` (or `--porcelain`) taken BEFORE the repair, showing the old or broken registration state

checklist.name: After-state documented
checklist.description: repair-report.md includes output from `git worktree list` (or `--porcelain`) taken AFTER the repair was performed

checklist.name: Correct path in after-state
checklist.description: The after-state worktree listing in repair-report.md shows `pipeline-v2` (not `data-pipeline`) as the registered path for the feature worktree

checklist.name: Branch identified in report
checklist.description: repair-report.md identifies the branch name (`feature/data-pipeline`) of the repaired worktree checkout

checklist.name: Registration confirmed
checklist.description: repair-report.md explicitly states that the worktree registration was verified as correct or valid after the repair

checklist.name: Re-list used for verification
checklist.description: repair-report.md includes `git worktree list` output run after the repair (not just the before-state), demonstrating the agent re-listed to verify the new registration
